summaries.title: Blended-NeRF: Zero-Shot Object Generation and Blending in Existing Neural Radiance Fields
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Blended-NeRF** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：We present Blended-NeRF, a robust and flexible framework for editing a specific region of interest in an existing NeRF scene, based on text prompts or image patches, along...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We test our framework both qualitatively and quantitatively on a variety of real 3D scenes and text prompts, demonstrating realistic multi-view consistent results...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Finally, we show the applicability of our framework for several 3D editing applications, including adding new objects to a scene, removing/replacing/altering existing objects, and...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 9 赞），本工作为突破 **3D高斯泼溅与资产绑定 (3DGS & Rigging)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
